operator_approval_scope: Serra Honda org only (24d64f99-ba04-4b43-af35-fd06f555ac86). DELETE bounded by organization_id in the WHERE clause.

classification_rule_drift_vs_original_ar.original_archaeology_classifier: 555-NXX position only (e.g. 412-555-0199 matches; +15550000001 does NOT match)
classification_rule_drift_vs_original_ar.this_run_classifier: 555-NXX OR 555-NPA position (NPA=555 is the NANP reserved test area code, e.g. +15551234567 matches)
classification_rule_drift_vs_original_ar.effect: 5 rows whose customer_name is literally a +1555... phone string move from non-test buckets to test-tagged buckets. All 5 are unambiguously test traffic.

proposed_delete_sql:
DELETE FROM conversations
WHERE id = ANY($1::uuid[])
  AND organization_id = $2
RETURNING id;
